My best guess is that Bahattin Baysal won the TÜBİTAK Science Award in 1985. That fits the team note that the award began in 1976 and that he was honored in the mid-1980s, but I can't verify the exact year. It replaces my earlier guess of 1977, which would have fallen in the award's first years rather than the mid-1980s.

CONFIDENCE: 25
